Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one character concept in a nine-member Steel Companion WR/Tarae redesign set. The attached image is the USER-ACCEPTED BASE DESIGN and mandatory identity/material/proportion reference. Create a newly posed and differentiated variant of this SAME cute wire-rod mascot, not a different franchise.
WORLD AND IDENTITY LOCK: premium PBR SILVER STEEL collectible figurine, an unusually large snug wound-wire HOOD holding a broad physically integrated rounded smooth steel face, small short solid-looking wound body, SHORT thick softly curved arms ending in broad little mitten hands, short rounded solid feet. Overall about TWO heads tall, cute cozy unthreatening silhouette. Simple black oval or curved eyes, tiny mouth; no human lips or teeth. Keep steel wire as material metaphor, not a literal manufactured finished part. The hood and body windings are closely packed and touch: do not expose empty skeleton. TOP OF HEAD IS A SIMPLE CLOSED ROUNDED DOME with NO protruding wire end, curl, loop, stalk, knob, antenna or horn. Face is flush in hood, NEVER a small suspended ball inside an empty ring. Preserve no-neck comforting compact proportions.
COLOR/MATERIAL: predominantly neutral silver brushed/satin metal, one tiny ochre #A0722A joining accent, no all-gold/bronze body. Controlled warm upper-right rim light and soft frontal fill, tactile metal, no heavy rust or excessive scratches. Same soft pale warm-grey studio backdrop and gentle contact shadow. No dramatic scenery. FULL BODY portrait 2:3 approx 1024x1536, mild near-front three-quarter view; complete hands/feet with safe margins, single character centered. Use pose, expression, wound-wire geometry and surface finish to distinguish this grade, as specified below. Maintain the base's level of cuteness on every grade.
EMPTY HANDS: no handheld objects, weapons, tools or equipment; functional inspiration is expressed through anatomy/acting only. No text, numbers, labels, grades, watermark, card frames, UI, pedestals, other characters or extra limbs. Avoid spooky mummies, bandage textures, skeletal anatomy, long wire limbs, ball hands on rods, loop feet, hairy cable, human hair, wool, yarn, cloth, heavy armor, reference character's copy-pasted pose.
The story below is ACTING INSPIRATION, not text to render or an engineering performance guarantee. Produce one independent polished concept image.
TARGET: wr-SWRM / SWRM10
Story: 아직 뭐가 될지는 나도 몰라. 어디로든 구부러져.
REQUIRED CHARACTER DIFFERENTIATION: The curious BEGINNER: soft broad gently flowing wire turns, roundest softest cheeks, a low broad rounded hood crown. One mitten hand open palm-up near waist and the other slightly out from the side in a small wondering shrug. Slight inquisitive head tilt, eyes glance gently upwards, a tiny wondering open smile. Relaxed stance with feet close together and one knee mildly bent. Three broad softly curved solid-packed torso turns. Friendly softness without any floppy stick limbs. Curious and approachable, no aggressive brows.
